name: HeadValue
documentation:
Optional head evidence carried by a lazy entity supplier, without allocating a separate metadata wrapper per
 node. Reading the head never reconstructs the value. Custom resolvers may continue returning ordinary suppliers
 when revision evidence is unavailable.

methods.name: head
methods.documentation: Returns the pinned revision without value reconstruction, or null for proven absence.

methods.name: type
methods.documentation: Returns the locally resolved class, Object for an absent untyped root, or null for an unknown child.
